companyNotes: PepsiCo hosts everything on its own Phenom-powered board, pepsicojobs.com — that is the source of record and every application URL above. CRITICAL CAVEAT FOR THIS RUN: this sandbox's egress proxy blocked WebFetch to every external host (linkedin.com, pepsico.com, pepsicojobs.com, even a Wikipedia calibration fetch), so all 22 matching listings were established purely from site-scoped web-search results; no description was read (all descriptionRead: false), so no posted dates, deadlines, or visa language could be verified — the checker should re-verify each URL from an environment with normal fetch access before queuing. Landscape found: (1) Canada dominates the current cycle — a large live Fall 2026 co-op wave (beyond the top 10: Sales Co-ops in Saskatoon 453386, Stoney Creek 457470, Dartmouth 452309, Cambridge 457473, London ON 457469, Delta AFH 452292, Surrey/Vancouver Frito Lay Sales Development 452228, Territory Sales Rep Co-op Mississauga 452296, H&S Supply Chain Co-op Peterborough 453963, Frito Lay Supply Chain Co-op Lethbridge/Taber 406850, plus a LinkedIn-only 'Fall 2026 HQ Supply Chain Co-op' 4407726644) and 2026/2027 New Grad programmes with Fall/Winter/Spring starts (also live: New Graduate Sales Leadership Program Winnipeg 2026, 449752). (2) US Summer 2027 intern cycle is just opening — only the two MBA postings so far; historically US applications open ~Aug 25 and close end of October, so a re-run in early September should catch the full undergrad/masters intern wave (US postings historically require US work eligibility — expect 'No – Right to Work Required' once readable). (3) UK currently lists mostly manufacturing/operative roles (excluded); placement-year postings typically appear in autumn — re-check. (4) Ireland (Cork) and South Africa graduate listings found were stale 2023–2024 postings; SA runs a Graduate Programme with the Kgodiso Fund but no live listing surfaced; nothing for Australia/NZ. Two umbrella postings ('PepsiCo Sales Co-Op - Fall 2026' 452858, 'PepsiCo Supply Chain Co-Op Fall 2026' 452875, both 'Multiple Locations') could not be pinned to a country and were left out of the count. LinkedIn numeric company ID still unknown — worth capturing on a future run for Method A.
